propositions: _blame_file_commits returns [] both on git failure and successful-but-empty blame, making the two cases indistinguishable.
_blame_file_commits must be changed to return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty result.
derive_caused_by should abort (return None) when any per-path blame fails, rather than tallying a partial set that can elect a wrong culprit.
A path whose blame legitimately yields zero lines must not abort the derivation.
Partial blame failure under a blobless promisor can persist an incorrect caused_by link, worse than writing none.
A clone-guidance doc must record measured blob:none vs full numbers and warn that --filter=tree:0 must not be used.
